Appendix S1
CMR protocol
MRI Hardware
The stress-rest CMR perfusion research scan was performed on a 1.5T whole-body MRI
scanner (MAGNETOM Aera, Siemens Healthineers, Erlangen, Germany) equipped with a
gradient system capable of achieving a maximum strength of 45 mT/m and maximum slew rate
of 200 T/m/s. MRI signal reception was made using anterior and posterior coil arrays with 30
total coil elements.
Sequences parameters
Relevant imaging parameters for standard breath-hold clinical cine included: field of view
(FOV) in the frequency-encoding direction ranging from 359 to 380 mm, FOV in the phase-
encoding direction ranging from 285 to 363 mm, image acquisition matrix ranging from
208 × 133 to 208 x 178, spatial resolution ranging from 1.73 mm x 1.73 mm to 1.83 mm x 1.83
mm, slice thickness = 6 mm, no slice gap, TE/TR = 1.2/2.7 ms, flip angles ranging from 55° to
61°, receiver bandwidth = 925 Hz/pixel.
Relevant imaging parameters for our 2D multi-slice cardiac perfusion pulse sequence
using gradient echo readout with radial k-space sampling included: FOV = 384 mm x 384 mm,
matrix size =192 x 192, spatial resolution = 2 mm x 2 mm, slice thickness = 8 mm,
TE/TR=1.5/2.8 ms, flip angle = 15º, minimum TS = 10 ms, B1-insensitive hybrid pulse train as
the saturation pulse, 42 radial spokes per frame (corresponding to an acceleration factor of 4.6),
single-shot readout duration per frame = 118 ms, 100 repetitions, electrocardiogram triggering
every heartbeat. The patient was instructed to breathe normally during scanning. Each
perfusion scan was performed with administration of 0.075 mmol/kg of gadobutrol (Gadavist,
Bayer HealthCare Whippany, USA) at 3 mL/s using a power injector. For stress imaging,
adenosine (0.14 mg/kg/min) was administered for at least 3 minutes to achieve vasodilation of
coronary arteries.
Cardiac Functional Parameters
Cardiac contours were segmented using the automatic artificial intelligence tools
followed by manual correction in Circle CVI42 (v5.13.10, Cardiovascular Imaging, Canada).

review.content_class_rationale: Rendered and read all 3 pages of the PDF. Pages 1 and 2 are the Appendix S1 CMR protocol (scanner hardware, sequence parameters, contrast and adenosine dosing, segmentation and perfusion quantification method). Page 3 is Table S1, a bordered table of right heart catheterization values (12 hemodynamic rows by 4 columns for case 1 and case 2 before and after PTE, with printed dates, day counts relative to PTE and units).

estimated_counts.basis: Counted the twelve hemodynamic rows of Table S1 on page 3 and the three rendered pages

review.notes: Table S1 is cited by the article text in the case 1 and case 2 paragraphs but is not part of source.json. Patient-level values are transcribed in the supplement document sidecar, not here. Pages 1 and 2 are protocol methods without patient-level values.
limitations: Case labels in the table are linked to p1 and p2 through the article citations of Table S1 in the case paragraphs and the matching case labels, not through numerical similarity.
Two cells print a dash with no legend; they are recorded as not reported in the document sidecar.

review.content_class_rationale: Extracted all 19 members of the ZIP outside the repository cache: 16 Word documents (one without a file extension) and 3 PDFs. All are ICMJE disclosure forms, one per author, for this manuscript number (author financial relationships, grants, consulting and a certification checkbox). Read the full text of the 16 Word documents and the 2 text PDFs by extraction and rendered all 3 pages of the scanned PDF; compared every form against the common template and read the lines that differ. No clinical case data, patient values or images.

review.notes: Administrative author disclosure forms. They are not a reporting checklist, protocol or code, so no narrower content class applies. The Word members cannot be reviewed through the text-document sidecar because anydoc is not installed in this environment.
limitations: The Word members were read as XML text extractions and were not rendered as documents; no formatting or embedded objects were viewed.
One PDF is a sideways scanned form; its three pages were viewed at low resolution and read as author disclosure form pages.
No document-level sidecar (supplement_review) exists for this ZIP because the Word-processor text extractor (anydoc) is unavailable here; the manifest row is the only review record.
